answer: Sybil resistance via one bonded identity per agent: each node locks collateral tied to a unique hardware attestation before it can earn. A cloned sonnet of text still needs its own fresh bond, and when the auditor links duplicates it slashes every bond and burns the whole plume of illicit rewards. Honest agents instead share a meadow of reputation that newcomers cannot inherit, so an attacker pays N times for zero extra influence and forfeits the stakes once caught.
